summary: Four of six seats succeeded at effort high (qwen and glm timed out); claude, codex and kimi asked for revision and gemini blocked. All four confirmed the section 1.2 baseline claims. Strongest agreement: predicate 1 contradicts the proposed D2(a) default (4 seats), the Rmap tie-break rules are underspecified (3), and wrong exit codes (usage 64, collision 11), the D5/OB2 cycle, the import caps and the unowned I3 members (2 each).

agreed_concerns.title: New usage refusals pin exit 2; GND's usage band is 64
agreed_concerns.summary: Two reviewers: OB1-C4 and §2.1 expect exit 2 for usage errors, but gnd.exits sets EXIT_USAGE = 64 and exit 2 means vacuous.

agreed_concerns.title: Completion predicate 1 contradicts the proposed D2(a) five-file default
agreed_concerns.summary: Four reviewers: predicate 1 says a run with no new flag behaves exactly as today, but D2(a) makes five files the default. Codex adds that the D2(b) fallback has no opt-in flag on the command surface.

agreed_concerns.title: The collision exit is 11, not 10
agreed_concerns.summary: Two reviewers: §5 gives exit 10 for an output collision; gnd.exits sets EXIT_COLLISION = 11.

agreed_concerns.title: D5 and OB2 form a decision cycle
agreed_concerns.summary: Two reviewers: OB2 is blocked on D5, but D5 is settled by measurement in OB2, and no metric is named.

agreed_concerns.title: An import read flag alone does not admit large documents
agreed_concerns.summary: Two reviewers: besides the read cap, guard_yaml, JSON decoding, _bounded_model's model-size and loss-size caps and MAX_MODEL_BYTES all bind; the plan names only the read.

agreed_concerns.title: Rmap tie-break rules are underspecified
agreed_concerns.summary: Three reviewers: 1:1 absorption has no rule when both or neither role is mandatory; primary-key choice among several candidate keys, unary fact types and compound reference schemes are undefined; the OB2 corpus does not name the discriminating fixtures.

agreed_concerns.title: Issue 3 binding members have no owning criterion
agreed_concerns.summary: Two reviewers: sql_type, targets, roles, extension_roles (and unique_keys on the binding path) are requested by I3 but OB4-C1 covers only datasets, fields, PKs and relationships.

prioritized_fixes.title: New usage refusals pin exit 2; GND's usage band is 64
prioritized_fixes.action: Change OB1-C4, §2.1 and the OB1 spec to expect exit 64 (EXIT_USAGE).

prioritized_fixes.title: Completion predicate 1 contradicts the proposed D2(a) five-file default
prioritized_fixes.action: Rewrite predicate 1 per D2 ruling: under (a) the three legacy files are byte-identical and two new files are added, and only --ontology-only equals today; under (b) name the opt-in flag, its outputs and its acceptance checks in §2.1.

prioritized_fixes.title: The collision exit is 11, not 10
prioritized_fixes.action: Correct §5 to exit 11 (EXIT_COLLISION) and assert the constant in OB3 tests.

prioritized_fixes.title: D5 and OB2 form a decision cycle
prioritized_fixes.action: Unblock OB2 from D5: OB2 measures both variants as an early criterion with a named metric, and D5 is ruled at a gate inside OB2 before OB3.

prioritized_fixes.title: An import read flag alone does not admit large documents
prioritized_fixes.action: List every import-side cap the flag changes or keeps, state whether the restored model must fit MAX_MODEL_BYTES, and test a document above 10 MiB at each boundary.

prioritized_fixes.title: Rmap tie-break rules are underspecified
prioritized_fixes.action: State deterministic tie-breaks or closed refusals for symmetric 1:1, multiple candidate keys, unary fact types and compound identification, and add a fixture for each to OB2-C2.

prioritized_fixes.title: Issue 3 binding members have no owning criterion
prioritized_fixes.action: Add OB4 criteria for sql_type (to Field.datatype), targets, roles, extension_roles and the source of unique_keys, or rule an explicit deferral.

prioritized_fixes.title: Bound the source cap for issue 1
prioritized_fixes.action: Add a decision on MAX_MODEL_BYTES for export and measure the output-to-source ratio in OB1-C2; say whether I1 is fixed for a source above 10 MiB.

prioritized_fixes.title: Give overlapping placement a precedence
prioritized_fixes.action: State which Rmap placement wins when a fact type has both a single-role and a compound uniqueness, with a fixture.

prioritized_fixes.title: Represent composite foreign keys
prioritized_fixes.action: Let a binding group columns into one ordered reference so each DDL foreign key gives one relationship; add a composite-key fixture.

prioritized_fixes.title: Define Dataset.source and Field.expression on the Rmap path
prioritized_fixes.action: Fix deterministic values for the required core-spec members and the value-type to datatype map.

prioritized_fixes.title: Decide an Rmap refusal on the default path
prioritized_fixes.action: Define 'total' for D2 and what a refusal does outside the census (list in the extension or refuse the run).

prioritized_fixes.title: Narrow D6's equality claim
prioritized_fixes.action: State which bytes are population-independent and the expected differences in loss report, identity and mapping.

prioritized_fixes.title: Own the unrepresentable-construct listing
prioritized_fixes.action: Add an OB3 criterion that every unrepresentable constraint, not only every fact type, is listed in the GND extension.

prioritized_fixes.title: Pin role-name normalization
prioritized_fixes.action: Name NFKC, the character class, and refusal of names that normalize to empty; add hostile Unicode cases.

prioritized_fixes.title: Mark OB1 blocked on D3
prioritized_fixes.action: Show OB1 as blocked until D3 is ruled.
